capabilities: Number headings and mark the active line
Convert and edit Markdown and HTML tables
Customize banners, icons, and line width
Enhance Mermaid diagrams and PDF exports
extras: No analytics or telemetry; Community build runs bundled Mermaid locally, while the optional Full build downloads remote Mermaid/ELK JavaScript from jsDelivr. Bundled renderer makes main.js exceed Obsidian Sync Standard's 5 MB per-file limit.
intentEvidence: Focused fixes and enhancements for Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian offers little control over callout editing, heading numbers, reading width, icons, diagrams, tables, and PDF navigation.

relations.evidence: Line Width was inspired by Mugisho Mugisho’s Editor Width Slider.
Patch Icons was inspired by Florian Woelki’s Iconize.

summary: Multi-feature enhancement plugin adding callout editing, heading numbering, line-width control, banners, icons, Mermaid tools, HTML tables, and PDF bookmarks.
